subject: maths
question: What would be the compound interest on Rs. 15,750 at 20% per annum, in two years, if the interest is compounded half yearly?
solution:
Given:

Principal = Rs. 15,750

Rate = 20% half yearly

Time = 2 years

Concept used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Princ
